title: Cycling Hainan - 700km on an Alvas DA54

takeaways.text: The bike was custom-designed for the channel by ALVAS about six months earlier; it carries ALVAS's own carbon crank and Helux DD8 wheels of about 1,200 g at 50 mm depth with a 30 mm internal width.
On rough roads into a headwind the aggressive position and wide rims at 80 psi kept it comfortable; with 9 kg of luggage he averaged around 30 km/h over 250 km.
It climbed well on 5–8% grades with luggage; set up like his Canyon Aeroad CFR, he judged it a race bike that held up over about 700 km with no reported faults.

disclosure: ALVAS custom-designed this bike for the channel, which says it has worked with the brand and visited its factories; the channel's clothing is sponsored.
summary: A self-supported ride across Hainan on China Rides' custom ALVAS DA54 with Helux DD8 wheels, focused on durability, speed with luggage and climbing.
